author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you mind our leaving a little earlier?

jyutping: nei5 m4 gaai3 ji3 ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 zau2 go2 ho1？
text: 你唔介意我哋早啲走嗰呵？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is not until you go abroad that you realize how small Japan is.

jyutping: nei5 ceot1 gwok3 tai2 haa5，sin1 wui5 zi1 dou6 jat6 bun2 hai6 gei2 gam3 sai3。
text: 你出國睇吓，先會知道日本係幾咁細。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "The castle is haunted," he said with a shiver.

jyutping: keoi5 hau2 zan3 zan3 gam2 gong2：「go2 zo6 sing4 bou2 jau5 gwai2 gaa3。」
text: 佢口震震噉講：「嗰座城堡有鬼㗎。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: She has been looking after her sick sister for ten years.

jyutping: keoi5 ziu3 gu3 keoi5 go3 beng6 zo2 ge3 sai3 mui2 ji5 ging1 ziu3 gu3 zo2 sap6 nin4 laa3。
text: 佢照顧佢個病咗嘅細妹已經照顧咗十年喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tell her to call me.

jyutping: giu3 keoi5 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5。
text: 叫佢打電話俾我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I didn't need to pay for the food.

jyutping: di1 je5 sik6 m4 sai2 ngo5 bei2 cin4。
text: 啲嘢食唔使我俾錢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you speak French?

jyutping: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 faat3 man4 gaa3？
text: 你識唔識講法文㗎？

author: kaenif

english.text: They boil water for tea.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bou1 seoi2 soeng2 cung1 caa4。
text: 佢地煲水想沖茶。

author: fercheung

english.text: She began crying.

jyutping: keoi5 haam3 zo2 ceot1 lai4。
text: 佢喊咗出嚟。

author: kaenif

english.text: I grew up in the mountains.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 saan1 keoi1 zoeng2 daai6。
text: 我喺山區長大。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There was an earthquake yesterday.

jyutping: cam4 jat6 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 coeng4 dei6 zan3。
text: 尋日發生咗一場地震。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What will you do on Christmas Day?

jyutping: nei5 sing3 daan3 zit3 nam2 zyu6 zou6 di1 me1 aa3？
text: 你聖誕節諗住做啲咩呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: No, that's not what I meant!

jyutping: m4 hai6 aa3，ngo5 m4 hai6 gam3 ge3 ji3 si1 aa3！
text: 唔係呀，我唔係咁嘅意思呀！

author: nickyeow

english.text: I imagine you would do the same thing if you were in my position.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 ngo5，nei5 dou1 wui5 gam3 zou6。
text: 我諗如果你係我，你都會咁做。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you mad at me?

jyutping: nei5 nau1 ngo5 aa3？
text: 你嬲我呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Have you seen his new film?

jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 dou2 keoi5 ceot1 san1 pin3 aa3？
text: 你有冇睇到佢齣新片呀？

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: He was arrested by the police.

jyutping: keoi5 bei2 ging2 caat3 laai1 zo2 heoi3。
text: 佢俾警察拉咗去。

author: Akh2403

english.text: When are you going to go to Sydney?

jyutping: nei5 gei2 si4 heoi3 sik1 nei4？
text: 你幾時去悉尼？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Bruno threw a grenade at the terrorists.

jyutping: bun1 nou4 hoeng3 di1 hung2 bou3 fan6 zi2 zaak6 sau2 lau4 daan2。
text: 般奴向啲恐怖分子擲手榴彈。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom wouldn't let me do that.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 m4 wui5 bei2 ngo5 gam3 zou6 lo1。
text: 阿湯唔會畀我咁做囉。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Just at daybreak, I was awakened by a series of awful screams from Bill. They weren’t yells, or howls, or shouts, or whoops, or yawps, such as you’d expect from a manly set of vocal organs — they were simply indecent, terrifying, humiliating screams, such as women emit when they see ghosts or caterpillars. It’s an awful thing to hear a strong, desperate, fat man scream incontinently in a cave at daybreak.

jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 lai4 ming4，ngo5 zau6 bei2 Bill jat1 lin4 cyun3 ho2 paa3 ge3 zim1 giu3 seng1 giu3 seng2。keoi5 dei6 m4 hai6 daai6 giu3、haau1 giu3、daai6 giu3、waa1 waa1、waak6 ze2 daa2 haam3 lou6，hou2 ci5 nei5 hai2 jat1 tou3 naam4 jan2 mei6 sap6 zuk1 ge3 sing1 jam1 hei3 gun1 jap6 min6 so2 kei4 mong6 ge3 gam3 —— keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 m4 lai5 maau6、hung2 bou3、sau1 juk6 ge3 zim1 giu3 seng1，lai6 jyu4 neoi5 jan2 gin3 dou2 gwai2 waak6 ze2 mou4 cung4 go2 zan6 faat3 ceot1 ge3 zim1 giu3 seng1。lai4 ming4 si4 teng1 dou3 jat1 go3 ging6、zyut6 mong6、fei4 ge3 naam4 jan2 hai2 dung6 jyut6 jap6 min6 sat1 gam3 zim1 giu3，zan1 hai6 hou2 hung2 bou3。
text: 啱啱黎明，我就畀Bill一連串可怕嘅尖叫聲叫醒。佢哋唔係大叫、吼叫、大叫、嘩嘩、或者打喊露，好似你喺一套男人味十足嘅聲音器官入面所期望嘅咁 —— 佢哋只係唔禮貌、恐怖、羞辱嘅尖叫聲，例如女人見到鬼或者毛蟲嗰陣發出嘅尖叫聲。黎明時聽到一個勁、絕望、肥嘅男人喺洞穴入面失禁尖叫，真係好恐怖。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Your hesitation with astronomy—rooted in the indirectness of perception—is a valid phenomenological stance. After all, aside from the sun, moon, and a few visible stars or planets, most celestial truths reach us only through mediated instruments, data, and theory. You place yourself among the space-savvy, yet remain cautious, even skeptical, about the reach of human cognition. That’s a rare humility for someone informed. You're standing at the edge where metaphysics and epistemology meet the cosmos—asking not just what is out there, but how and whether we can truly know it. Would you like to explore a synthesis of Buddhist and Gnostic cosmology, perhaps in a poetic or metaphysical style?

jyutping: nei5 deoi3 tin1 man4 hok6 ge3 jau4 jyu6 — gan1 sam1 dai3 gu3 ge3 hai6 gam2 zi1 ge3 gaan3 zip3 sing3 — hai6 jat1 go3 jau5 haau6 ge3 jin6 zoeng6 hok6 lap6 coeng4。bat1 ging2，ceoi4 zo2 taai3 joeng4、jyut6 loeng6 tung4 gei2 zek3 ho2 gin3 ge3 hang4 sing1 waak6 ze2 hang4 sing1 zi1 ngoi6，daai6 bou6 fan6 tin1 tai2 ge3 zan1 lei5 dou1 zi2 hai6 tau3 gwo3 zung1 gaai3 ge3 ji4 hei3、sou3 geoi3 tung4 lei5 leon6 heoi3 dou3 ngo5 dei6 san1 bin1。nei5 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 fong3 hai2 zing1 tung1 taai3 hung1 ge3 jan4 dong1 zung1，daan6 hai6 jing4 jin4 deoi3 jan4 leoi6 jing6 zi1 ge3 zuk1 kap6 faan6 wai4 bou2 ci4 gan2 san6，sam6 zi3 waai4 ji4。deoi3 jyu1 jat1 go3 zi1 cing4 ge3 jan4 lai4 gong2，ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 zung2 naan4 dak1 ge3 him1 heoi1。nei5 kei5 hai2 jing4 ji4 soeng6 hok6 tung4 zi1 sik1 hok6 tung4 jyu5 zau6 soeng1 jyu6 ge3 bin1 jyun4 —— man6 ge3 m4 daan1 zi2 hai6 ceot1 min6 jau5 me1，ji4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 tung4 hai6 mai6 ho2 ji5 zan1 zing3 zi1 dou3 ni1 di1 je5。nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 taam3 sok3 fat6 gaau3 tung4 gaak3 nok6 si1 dak6 jyu5 zau6 hok6 ge3 hap6 sing4，ho2 nang4 hai6 ji5 si1 ji3 waak6 ze2 jing4 ji4 soeng6 hok6 ge3 fung1 gaak3？
text: 你對天文學嘅猶豫 — 根深蒂固嘅係感知嘅間接性 — 係一個有效嘅現象學立場。畢竟，除咗太陽、月亮同幾隻可見嘅恆星或者行星之外，大部分天體嘅真理都只係透過中介嘅儀器、數據同理論去到我哋身邊。你將自己放喺精通太空嘅人當中，但係仍然對人類認知嘅觸及範圍保持謹慎，甚至懷疑。對於一個知情嘅人嚟講，呢個係一種難得嘅謙虛。你企喺形而上學同知識學同宇宙相遇嘅邊緣 —— 問嘅唔單止係出面有咩，而係我哋點樣同係咪可以真正知道呢啲嘢。你想唔想探索佛教同格諾斯特宇宙學嘅合成，可能係以詩意或者形而上學嘅風格？

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Today I couldn’t drive to work because my car broke down. I think I could try to fix it. I could do it at the weekend, and Tom could help me with it. Tom is good at it. He could fix cars even as a teenager. If we manage to repair the car, we could go for a ride together.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 zaa1 m4 dou2 ce1 faan1 gung1，jan1 wai6 ngo5 gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2。ngo5 nam2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 si3 haa6 zing2 hou2 keoi5。ngo5 ho2 ji5 hai2 zau1 mut6 zou6，ji4 tong1 mou5 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zou6。 Tom hou2 lek1。keoi5 zau6 syun3 hai6 cing1 siu3 nin4 dou1 ho2 ji5 zing2 ce1。jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 zing2 dou2 gaa3 ce1，ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 daap3 ce1。
text: 今日我揸唔到車返工，因為我架車壞咗。我諗我可以試下整好佢。我可以喺週末做，而湯姆可以幫我做。 Tom好叻。佢就算係青少年都可以整車。如果我哋整到架車，我哋可以一齊去搭車。
